summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on the results of its Annual General Meeting held June 30, 2026. Ordinary resolutions 1–7 passed with 73%–94% majority; ordinary resolution 8 and special resolutions 10 and 11 failed. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting outcome report with no special-situation event such as M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. The meeting was a standard annual general meeting, and the failed resolutions relate to ordinary corporate governance items, not a transformative event.
